Reviewed the post-forward authority-change 409 wording: a mutation is now explicitly unconfirmed, while its status, headers and conservative delivery classification remain unchanged. Missing source-authored refusal evidence still cannot prove non-delivery. Foreground execution checks an existing conversation environment against the resolved receiver before reserving/invoking; commands use the receiver orchestration service/local adapter registry rather than a caller-selected remote target. Reviewed the shared-checkout fixture correction: it now uses a tracked real temporary directory in the host filesystem instead of POSIX-only /srv/station. It still checks that shared execution starts in the configured checkout without provisioning another worktree. All 67 execution-target cases passed on Windows, including environment mismatch before child reservation; the fixture change does not change runtime isolation policy. Added source links for the real-queue mounted regression and its two controls. Four interaction cases failed on the old implementation; all five cases passed after the fix (8.38 seconds), including a retired lease. Existing outbox/unsent component suites also passed. The real relay browser recheck is reported separately, not inferred from these component tests.
